gaps.title: sword_hit ends in a quarter-second of bright hiss
gaps.detail: sword_hit is the only impact calling blade with tail=1: two wide noise bands held at 68-80 percent of peak from 50ms to 240ms, plus 16.5 LU over the battle theme at 150ms in 3-6kHz, so a connected hit reads as a swipe at air and lasts longer than the miss whoosh. Replace the held envelope with a fast exponential decay (minus 10dB by 30ms, gone by 90-110ms) and sweep the tail lowpass 6kHz down to 1.5kHz over 60ms, keeping the snap and low body.
